summary: Extended Dashboard Background CMS + new Login Background section verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 10/10 (public exposes all 7 new fields; PUT persists dashboard_bg_fit/blur and login_bg_enabled/url/opacity/fit/blur; opacity clamped 4..24, blur 0..12, fit non-cover/center coerced to cover; CONTENT_MANAGER PUT OK; CUSTOMER_SERVICE PUT 403 / GET OK; unauth PUT 401). Frontend Playwright: /admin/visuals shows all new controls (visuals-dashboard-fit/blur/blur-value + full loginbg set incl. preview/upload/pick/url/opacity/opacity-value/fit/blur/blur-value/reset). Enabling+saving dashboard bg with fit=center blur=6 -> admin-bg-overlay style contains background-size:contain and filter:blur(6px). Enabling+saving login bg -> fresh incognito /login shows login-bg-overlay with correct URL, opacity 0.18, blur(5px); login-email/password/submit still visible. Default /login (custom bg disabled) has NO login-bg-overlay and keeps login-panel-image. Reset flows via API restore all defaults; verified via GET /api/settings/public. FREEZE preserved: certificate counter last_number=14, certificates/gemstones/customers all 0. Console errors: 0 across the flow.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.py admin_update_visuals loop over ('dashboard_bg','login_bg') cleanly reuses the same clamp logic for both prefixes — good DRY.
Server clamps opacity 4..24 and blur 0..12; fit whitelist to cover/center — defense-in-depth matches UI ranges.
AdminLayout overlay maps fit=center to background-size:contain and applies CSS filter blur() only when custom is enabled — verified in live DOM style.
LoginPage renders absolute login-bg-overlay only when login_bg_enabled AND login_bg_url set; form column keeps relative stacking so inputs are usable above overlay.
